notes.title: Update 1.0.26
notes.content:
Train Valley Origins update version 1.0.26 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive @everyone :



 Minor optimization

 Workshop level description now has a character limit counter next to its text field (250 characters)

 Two depots placed next tot each other will no longer cause issues like trains passing through a depot's walls and/pr crashing trains upon scheduling

 Going back to Workshop from a level's page will now put you right back into the previous Workshop page you've been at



We're back from holidays and are addressing bugs again :) Please let us know what you think about the update and good luck with tonight's LPT!

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.0.24
notes.content:
Train Valley Origins update version 1.0.24 is now available - restart your game and/or Steam client to receive :

And good luck with tonight's LPT!

notes.title: Update 1.0.23
notes.content:
Train Valley Origins update version 1.0.23 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive :



 You are now able to use all 20 depots on a single level - and level editor will not get stuck on profitability calculations

 Workshop browser now supports some more exotic screen resolutions



Good luck with tonight's LPT!

notes.title: The Level editor update is here!
notes.content:
The very same editor we've used to create Train Valley Origin's campaign is now available!
 

Shape your design and choose from 4 special mechanics

Garnish it with more than 500 decorative objects

Unlock 64 additional decorations as you play and earn XP

Publish levels and download other player's creations through the in-game browser - we have prepared 17 brand new levels for you to try (look for Grem19's submissions) and get acquainted with the workshop while you do

Then head over to your Steam profile and get yourself a Train Valley Origins badge with all the Train Valley Origins Steam trading cards you've earned :)



But that of course isn't all.


We are hosting a level design contest with Steam wallet funds prizes:


You have until 1st of September to devise a level and upload it

We will choose 5 winners at the end of the contest based on a weekly level roundup

There are no specific requirements except that your level should be completable :)



As always please do not hesitate and contact us with any questions or suggestions. Now go, build a puzzle or five :)


Discord🖥️Twitter / X 🖥️Facebook

notes.title: Update 1.0.21
notes.content:
Train Valley Origins update version 1.0.21 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive :

 Bridge segment prices were fixed for straight and sloped segments, and one can no longer delete a part of a bridge as well - it's either all or nothing :)

 Switches are now visible through every kind of obstruction



Drop us a line, tell us what you think!

notes.title: Update 1.0.20
notes.content:
Friday LPT is almost upon us and a Train Valley Origins update version 1.0.20 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive:



 Train's info badge will no longer be visually blocked after a wrong delivery

 Rail half segment no longer disappear when connecting to a depot or another dead end, sloping down half segments are fixed too

 Your trains will no longer spawn slightly behind a depot's back wall when sent out

 A switch you get when connecting tracks to an existing route will now block itself correctly

 Some depots have received animations

 Planning tracks past a 90 degree junction will no longer get stuck on that junction

 A Tier 5 Wolf locomotive (or any other locomotive you might be missing after reaching level 18) is waiting for you in the Train Shed

 Level 39 explosions in close to each other depots are gone



Drop us a line, tell us what you think!

notes.title: Update 1.0.17
notes.content:
Steam Summer Sale 2025 starting day update for Train Valley Origins version 1.0.17 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive:


  Depot marker will now stay out of the way when looking at its outgoing tracks

  Buying and selling tracks price hints now have backgrounds for better visibility

  Level 39 (The Pagoda) Bank and Windmill depots will no longer blow up your trains by teleporting them around

  You're no longer able to add a tunnel piece to a bridge on level 27 (Waterfalls)

  Freezing while unlocking a new locomotive card has been eliminated

  Building a bridge from a 90 degree track intersection was disabled and will no longer spawn a tunnel segment

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.content:
Midweek update for Train Valley Origins version 1.0.16 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive:



You're no longer able to break the game by building tracks in specific areas of Yellowstone (#14)

China levels now have a dedicated Passengers depot model



Keep the feedback coming everyone ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Update 1.0.15
notes.content:
Pre-weekend update for Train Valley Origins version 1.0.15 is now available - restart your game/Steam client to receive:

 Fixed tearing cars from their locomotives by deleting a switch/junction

 Level 35 trains will no longer leave the station with a Diamond car already attached

 Fixed tearing cars from their locomotives by delivering a sped up train into a wrong depot

 Fixed tearing cars from their locomotives by building a turn right under the locomotive's wheels as it tries to drive straight

 Fixed the game locking you into building straight tracks only in track planning mode

 Fixed deleting anything other than track tiles counting towards the Do not delete more than X track tiles

As always, many thanks for every issue and bug you brought to our attention, we're looking forward to your feedback ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.content:
Train Valley Origins 1.0.13 is out - restart your game/Steam client to receive: 

* Fixed Steam cloud overwriting your progress with an empty file and erasing your progress when playing from separate computers

* Removed ability to send your train underground by breaking a bridge in track planning mode

* Added green income popup message upon a train's arrival to a depot

* Fixed building bridges going down a double slope sometimes breaking in track planning mode

* Made special effects invisible before the level's tiles spawn in

* Fixed the "Prevent trains from autoscheduling" challenge failing when starting a train out of a depot that already has another train coming in or going out

 Thank you for all your reports and suggestions, keep those coming ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Get ready to Think Inside The Box 📦
notes.content:
Do you love designing the ultimate factory while solving challenging puzzles? Automate It combines the satisfaction of optimization with level-based gameplay that will put your engineering skills to the test.

Your goal? Build the best-automated systems while optimizing for both space and power usage. Thousands of solutions exist — how efficient can you be?

Automate It Demo includes:


 13 handcrafted levels designed to push your problem-solving and optimization skills to the limit.
 Weekly and Random challenges – it’s not just about making things work, but making them work better. Your solutions will be scored based on space and power usage.
 Global Leaderboard – optimize your solutions and compete with other players.
 Community Hub and Level Editor (demo version) – create your own challenges and share them with the community.
 4 Achievements specifically designed for this Demo!
 Multiple ways to solve each challenge – there’s no single correct answer, so experiment and find the best approach!


The main game will feature a full campaign with 50 unique scenarios, a Full Level Editor, and some other surprising goodies!

Check out the Automate It Demo 🏭
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472770/Automate_It/
After you’ve played the demo, it would be amazing if you could take a moment to leave a review. Even a few words go a long way in helping indie devs get more visibility on Steam. Plus, they’d love to hear your thoughts and see what you think!
